vulnerability_analysis: The CMOVE contract has an owner-only blacklist function (addBlackList/addBlackLists) that can prevent any address from sending or receiving tokens. The _beforeTokenTransfer hook checks blackListedList[from] and blackListedList[to], reverting if either is blacklisted. This is a classic owner privilege abuse vulnerability - the owner has unrestricted power to freeze any user's tokens without governance, timelock, or justification.
attack_strategy: 1. Impersonate the contract owner using vm.prank() 2. Call addBlackList(victim_address) to blacklist the victim 3. Verify the blacklist state is set to true via the oracle check
step_by_step_plan: 1. Create interface for CMOVE contract with owner(), addBlackList(), and blackListedList() functions 2. In setUp(), initialize the contract interface and label addresses 3. In testExploit(), get the owner address, prank as owner, call addBlackList on victim, verify blacklist state
